deck_metadata.audience: All-audience working package: users, families, healthcare collaborators, strategic partners, investors, and internal team
deck_metadata.objective: Create a bilingual Arabic and English all-audience pitch package for Zaadk that can be adapted into investor, partner, customer, and internal discussion decks.
deck_metadata.template_or_style_source: Local Zaad mobile app repo and app icon; no external market sources provided

md_storyline.recommended_action: Use this master storyboard to align Zaadk's narrative, pick the target audience for the next version, add sourced traction and financial evidence, then convert the relevant branch into a native pitch deck.
md_storyline.why_now: Zaadk already has a concrete Arabic-first product shape around meal planning, lab-report interpretation, recipe guidance, tracking, family sharing, consultations, privacy, and Supabase-backed health data; the next value-creation step is to make the promise sharper and prove usage, outcomes, and economics.
proof_pillars: Arabic-first therapeutic nutrition experience built around real health contexts
Integrated flows across onboarding, meal planning, recipes, measurements, lab reports, family sharing, and consultations
Privacy and health-data posture supported by RLS, ownership controls, and encryption planning
Persuasion sequence starts from user anxiety and daily friction before introducing Zaadk as the bridge
Investor and public-market style content remains screen-grade until traction, financials, market data, and valuation support are provided
key_risks_or_objections: No verified user traction, retention, revenue, CAC, clinical outcomes, or market sizing were provided
Health claims must be carefully caveated and should not imply medical diagnosis or replacement of clinicians
Public-equity long/short pitch is not applicable unless Zaadk is a listed security or tied to a public-company trade expression
External circulation needs source tie-out and deck QC
next_steps: Choose the priority deck branch: investor, partner, consumer, healthcare collaborator, or internal strategy
Add app screenshots, KPI history, financial model, market sizing, competitor map, and evidence of user outcomes
Build a native editable deck when presentation tooling is available

slides.slide_title: Zaadk turns health data into daily nutrition decisions | زادك يحول البيانات الصحية إلى قرارات غذائية يومية
slides.slide_purpose: Open with the master thesis and all-audience promise.
slides.key_message: Zaadk should be introduced as an Arabic-first health nutrition companion that makes meal planning, lab insights, tracking, and family support easier to act on.
slides.recommended_visual: App icon plus phone-screen montage showing meals, lab reports, recipes, and tracking.
content_blocks: English: Zaadk helps users move from confusing health information to practical meals, measurements, and follow-up routines.
Arabic: زادك يساعد المستخدم على الانتقال من معلومات صحية مشتتة إلى وجبات عملية وقياسات ومتابعة واضحة.
Decision ask: choose the priority audience and approve source-backed deck build.
slides.speaker_notes: Start with the human anxiety and daily friction, not with a feature list.
footnotes: Product features supported by local app configuration and UX documentation; traction and outcomes not provided.
open_items: Provide current product screenshots and preferred brand spelling: Zaad, Zaadk, or زاد.

slides.slide_title: The pitch should begin with the user's world: food is daily, health data is confusing | يجب أن يبدأ العرض من عالم المستخدم: الطعام يومي والبيانات الصحية مربكة
slides.slide_purpose: Apply desire-then-solution sequencing before explaining Zaadk.
slides.key_message: Users and decision makers become more receptive when the deck first names the pressure: managing health through meals is constant, personal, and easy to abandon.
slides.recommended_visual: Current-state journey: report, goal, meal, family, measurement, follow-up.
content_blocks: English: The problem is not lack of advice; it is turning advice into a safe meal today and a routine tomorrow.
Arabic: المشكلة ليست نقص النصائح؛ بل تحويل النصيحة إلى وجبة آمنة اليوم وروتين قابل للاستمرار غدا.
slides.speaker_notes: This is the pitch-psychologist anchor: build desire and contrast before introducing the product.
footnotes: Psychological sequencing is a narrative recommendation, not a medical or clinical claim.
open_items: Add user interview quotes or onboarding drop-off data.

slides.slide_title: Zaadk connects the daily loop: profile, plan, meal, measurement, report, and family | زادك يربط الحلقة اليومية: الملف، الخطة، الوجبة، القياس، التحليل، والعائلة
slides.key_message: Zaadk is strongest when framed as a loop rather than a set of isolated screens.
slides.recommended_visual: Circular loop diagram with six product nodes.
content_blocks: English: Onboarding captures health context; meal plans and recipes translate it; tracking and reports update the plan; family sharing and consultation support adherence.
Arabic: الإعداد الأولي يجمع السياق الصحي؛ خطط الوجبات والوصفات تترجمه؛ التتبع والتحاليل يحدثان الخطة؛ مشاركة العائلة والاستشارة تدعمان الالتزام.
slides.speaker_notes: Use this page to make the product feel coherent and defensible.
footnotes: Supported by UX flows and typed app data structures.

slides.slide_title: Zaadk's user promise is practical safety, not perfect dieting | وعد زادك للمستخدم هو السلامة العملية وليس الحمية المثالية
slides.key_message: The strongest consumer message is that Zaadk reduces daily uncertainty for people managing weight, blood sugar, pressure, cholesterol, digestive issues, and related nutrition needs.
slides.recommended_visual: Before/after contrast: generic diet advice versus condition-aware meal routine.
content_blocks: English: Plan around calories, protein, sodium, timing, preferences, allergies, and lab markers.
Arabic: التخطيط حول السعرات والبروتين والصوديوم والتوقيت والتفضيلات والحساسيات ومؤشرات التحاليل.
slides.speaker_notes: Avoid implying diagnosis or treatment. Keep the promise around organization, decision support, and follow-up.
footnotes: Medical disclaimer required: Zaadk does not replace clinicians.
open_items: Add legal/clinical review of consumer claims.

slides.slide_title: Lab reports become nutrition-relevant guidance only when the source and limits stay visible | تصبح التحاليل مفيدة غذائيا عندما تبقى المصادر والحدود واضحة
slides.slide_purpose: Make health-data capability credible and cautious.
slides.key_message: Zaadk can explain nutrition-relevant markers such as glucose, lipids, kidney function, inflammation, electrolytes, vitamin D, and uric acid while preserving the original report context.
slides.recommended_visual: Lab-report upload flow with markers grouped by nutrition relevance.
content_blocks: English: The app supports camera, photo-library, and PDF upload flows for lab reports.
Arabic: يدعم التطبيق رفع التحاليل بالكاميرا أو الصور أو ملفات PDF.
slides.speaker_notes: This is high-trust territory. Lead with boundaries and privacy as much as capability.
footnotes: Supported by app.json permissions, UX flows, and lab-report types; extraction performance not provided.
open_items: Add extraction accuracy, supported report formats, clinician review posture, and error handling.

slides.slide_title: Family sharing can turn individual plans into household adherence | مشاركة العائلة يمكن أن تحول الخطة الفردية إلى التزام منزلي
slides.key_message: Zaadk's family value is practical: give the person who cooks or supports the user the right meal context without exposing the full health file.
slides.recommended_visual: Care circle: user, family cook, caregiver, dietitian.
content_blocks: English: Family sharing, caregiver/dietitian roles, and consultation flows can make the product more useful than a solo tracker.
Arabic: مشاركة العائلة وأدوار مقدم الرعاية وأخصائي التغذية وتدفقات الاستشارة تجعل المنتج أكثر فائدة من مجرد متتبع فردي.
slides.speaker_notes: For partners, this slide can become the bridge to clinics, employers, insurers, and wellness programs.
footnotes: Supported by profile membership types, family UX flow, and consultation screen flow.
open_items: Confirm sharing permissions, privacy model, partner workflow, and consultation operating model.

slides.slide_title: Trust is a product feature when health data, meals, and family access sit together | الثقة ميزة أساسية عندما تجتمع البيانات الصحية والوجبات ووصول العائلة
slides.slide_purpose: Elevate security and privacy into the commercial story.
slides.key_message: Zaadk's trust case should highlight user-owned data, row-level access controls, limited anonymous access, server-only sensitive keys, and planned encryption of sensitive report fields.
slides.recommended_visual: Security posture table: data type, access rule, protection, next hardening step.
content_blocks: English: Privacy is not a compliance appendix; it is central to adoption in health-adjacent products.
Arabic: الخصوصية ليست ملحقا تنظيميا؛ بل أساس القبول في المنتجات المرتبطة بالصحة.
slides.speaker_notes: State only what the repo supports; avoid overclaiming compliance certifications.
footnotes: Supported by database-security.md; certification/compliance status not provided.
open_items: Add privacy policy status, regulatory review, encryption implementation status, and security audit results.

slides.slide_title: Partners get a context-rich path to healthier food decisions, not just another app placement | يحصل الشركاء على مسار غني بالسياق لقرارات غذائية أفضل وليس مجرد ظهور داخل تطبيق
slides.slide_purpose: Adapt the pitch for healthcare, food, employer, insurer, clinic, and wellness partners.
slides.key_message: Zaadk can be positioned to partners as a behavior layer that connects nutrition intent with meals, recipes, monitoring, and referral or consultation paths.
slides.recommended_visual: Partner value map: clinics, dietitians, employers, food providers, labs, family caregivers.
content_blocks: English: Partner value comes from relevant context, better adherence support, and measurable follow-up loops.
Arabic: قيمة الشراكة تأتي من السياق المناسب ودعم الالتزام وحلقات متابعة قابلة للقياس.
slides.speaker_notes: Do not promise outcomes without evidence. Make partner pilots the near-term proof step.
footnotes: Partner economics and pipeline not provided.
open_items: Add named partner segments, signed partners, pilot design, and commercial terms.

slides.slide_title: The investor case depends on proving repeat use, trusted data, and scalable nutrition economics | تعتمد قصة المستثمر على إثبات الاستخدام المتكرر والثقة واقتصاديات التغذية القابلة للتوسع
slides.slide_purpose: Frame investment logic without inventing traction or valuation.
slides.key_message: Zaadk becomes investable when it shows that users return, plans improve decision quality, partners can distribute or monetize the product, and sensitive data is handled credibly.
slides.recommended_visual: Investment proof ladder: product proof, retention, partner proof, economics, expansion.
content_blocks: English: The investor deck should lead with retention and health-context engagement before valuation.
Arabic: يجب أن يبدأ عرض المستثمرين بالاحتفاظ والتفاعل المرتبط بالسياق الصحي قبل التقييم.
slides.speaker_notes: This slide is the investor gate. Keep the pitch screen-grade until metrics exist.
footnotes: No user, revenue, retention, or funding data provided.
open_items: Add KPI history, retention cohorts, revenue model, CAC, gross margin, funding ask, use of proceeds, and runway.

slides.slide_title: Public-equity pitch mode is watchlist-only unless Zaadk maps to a listed security | وضع الأسهم العامة يبقى للمراقبة فقط ما لم يرتبط زادك بورقة مالية مدرجة
slides.slide_purpose: Honor the public-equity long/short skill without implying a trade recommendation.
slides.key_message: Because no ticker, listed issuer, price, liquidity, market data, borrow, or valuation anchor was provided, Zaadk is not an actionable long/short pitch; it can only produce a screen-grade investability checklist.
slides.recommended_visual: Implementation gate table: ticker, price, liquidity, valuation, catalyst, disconfirmers, risk rules.
content_blocks: English: Actionability: watchlist / not actionable as a public-equity trade. Upgrade only if a listed issuer or trade expression is provided.
Arabic: قابلية التنفيذ: قائمة مراقبة / غير قابل للتنفيذ كصفقة أسهم عامة. يترقى فقط عند توفير شركة مدرجة أو أداة تداول واضحة.
slides.speaker_notes: Do not provide account-specific investment advice or invent a public market expression.
footnotes: Public-equity long/short skill is not fully applicable without listed-security context.
open_items: Provide ticker, side, horizon, valuation anchor, catalyst, liquidity, borrow/carry if short, and risk budget if a public-equity pitch is required.

slides.slide_title: Revenue should follow trust: subscription, care programs, partners, and consultations only work after habit forms | يجب أن يتبع الإيراد الثقة: الاشتراك والبرامج والشراكات والاستشارات تنجح بعد تكوين العادة
slides.slide_purpose: Translate product engagement into monetization paths.
slides.key_message: The business model should be staged: first retention and trust, then paid plans, professional consultations, employer or clinic programs, partner distribution, and premium family/care features.
slides.recommended_visual: Revenue roadmap with proof threshold for each lane.
content_blocks: English: Treat monetization as sequenced proof, not a menu of disconnected revenue ideas.
Arabic: التعامل مع الإيراد كسلسلة إثبات متدرجة وليس قائمة أفكار منفصلة.
slides.speaker_notes: Use this page for investors and strategic partners; keep consumer-facing decks simpler.
footnotes: Revenue model and pricing not provided.
open_items: Confirm pricing, subscription status, consultation economics, partner model, payment flows, and gross margin.

slides.slide_title: The go-to-market path should start where trust and daily urgency are highest | يجب أن يبدأ التوسع حيث تكون الثقة والحاجة اليومية أعلى
slides.slide_purpose: Define GTM logic for all audiences.
slides.key_message: Zaadk should prioritize segments with repeated nutrition decisions: chronic-condition users, family caregivers, dietitian workflows, employer wellness, clinics, labs, and culturally familiar meal-planning communities.
slides.recommended_visual: GTM segmentation matrix by urgency and trust requirement.
content_blocks: English: Start with high-need, high-frequency use cases before expanding into general wellness.
Arabic: البدء بحالات عالية الحاجة وعالية التكرار قبل التوسع إلى الصحة العامة.
slides.speaker_notes: This is where pitch psychology and business discipline meet: urgency, trust, and frequency should control the first wedge.
footnotes: No acquisition or channel data provided.
open_items: Add channel mix, CAC, conversion funnel, referral loops, target cities, and launch cohorts.

slides.slide_title: The next 90 days should convert Zaadk from promising product into evidence-backed story | يجب أن تحول الأيام التسعون القادمة زادك من منتج واعد إلى قصة مدعومة بالأدلة
slides.key_message: Zaadk needs a source pack, KPI baseline, product screenshots, market map, financial model, claim review, and deck QC before external fundraising or partner circulation.
content_blocks: English: Build proof in this order: product truth, user truth, clinical/claim boundaries, business economics, partner evidence, investor story.
Arabic: بناء الإثبات بهذا الترتيب: حقيقة المنتج، حقيقة المستخدم، حدود الادعاءات الصحية، الاقتصاديات، أدلة الشراكات، قصة المستثمر.
slides.speaker_notes: End with remembered clarity: Zaadk is strong as a product narrative, but must earn evidence before external circulation.
footnotes: Readiness judgment reflects missing source and model support.
open_items: Run ib-deck-qc after citations, model support, and native deck rendering are complete.
